title: The header card carries a clearable Sales Representative field
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Owner/Admin user (that role holds every permission, including Part sales - Create & Edit).
  • A customer to sell to exists.
  • A part sale that is not invoiced or paid, for the customer, with a part (for example "Brake Pads"; Quantity 1; Sell Price for example $290.91).
  • The shop has at least one active sales representative.
custom_steps:
1. Open the part sale and read its header card (below the sale number and Started date).
  2. Find the Sales Representative field (it reads Unassigned when empty) and click it to open its picker.
  3. Select a rep, then clear the field.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The header card carries a Sales Representative field.
  • The picker offers the shop's active sales representatives (Unassigned first), and the field can be cleared. (On a shop with no reps flagged the picker reads "No results".)

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667 (Founder Mode Batch #1); story SV-10266 (Attribute a part sale to a sales representative); Part Sales Update v1 PRD (Confluence 867434569), Story 5; design canvas boards S5_*; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026; not yet build-verified.
